title: Barry says the secrecy sucks
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Barry says the secrecy sucks, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Holy cow. Can you believe this is being kept secret?" And he goes, "I it sucks. I know."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in Nevada where he says alien craft were studied, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a moment with a colleague named Barry Castilio. Lazar says he asked, "Can you believe this is being kept secret?" and Barry answered that it sucks, which would mean even the insiders were uneasy about the secrecy.
